$comment: The 22 fields `legacy/prompts/11-extraction_key_value_invoice_prompt.yaml` declares, as a JSON Schema the provider constrains generation with. It is a SEPARATE artifact from the prompt on purpose (two artifacts, one per concern): the prompt says what to look for and how to read it, the schema says what shape the answer must have. They are kept in step by `test_the_schema_and_the_prompt_agree_on_the_fields` rather than by being generated from one another.

comprobante_valido.description: 'true' when the text is a readable receipt, 'false' when it is not

motivo_rechazo.description: Why the document was rejected, or 'null'

cuit_emisor.description: the emitter's CUIT, digits and its own hyphens only

subtotal.description: as printed - never reformatted into a number

importe_total_facturado.description: the total as printed, with no adjustment

categoria_gasto.description: Restaurante | Supermercado | Hospedaje | Combustible | Movilidad/Pasajes | Peajes | Herramientas | Otros | null

centro_de_costo.description: always 'null' at extraction: filled by a later classification step
